note: Regional park on the west shore of Wakaw Lake with a sandy beach and swimming area, a 9-hole golf course with a licensed clubhouse restaurant, a marina with a boat launch and gas dock, 18-hole mini golf and canoe, kayak and paddle-boat rentals.  Mostly seasonal: about 145 of its 313 sites are sold by the night (or week or month); the other 168 are permanent.  Campers under 19 must be with a parent or guardian. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park, local) with a mostly-seasonal line: 145 of 313 sites rented daily/weekly/monthly, 168 permanent. Phone booking (front gate), C$38-51 taxes in, park entry C$13/day to fees.entrance, 50 A full service, season May 1 - Sep 30 (2026). Not waterfront kept. Pin at the front gate; move ~360 m into the campground loops. Website: add the park's own site.
flags: LONG-STAY (local): 145 of 313 sites rentable (46%) - 'With 313 total campsites — 168 permanent and 145 available for daily, weekly, or monthly rental' (park /camp/ page). Nightly rates posted, phone booking; monthly sites go by a draw. No wording discouraging nightly guests. Note says 'Mostly seasonal'.
GOOGLE: 4.1 (235 reviews); the place also covers the golf course and clubhouse restaurant, so not the campground's alone.

The near-empty loops that look like the rental area (about 52.6626,-105.6070) sit on a wooded bank 20-60 m above and back from the shore with trees between; the shoreline rows NE of the beach are packed (permanent-looking) and behind trees. No site map or site list identifies nightly sites, so nothing can be named; imagery z17 only.
